divergences.summary: Non-UTF-8 bytes: Brush's words, values and input are UTF-8 text (known bug: rejected, panics, or U+FFFD/Latin-1 re-encoding)
compgen -f does not expand ~ and $var in the word or quote results; compgen -A command lists differ
Error message wording, and the status of some usage errors, differ from Bash
echo under xpg_echo and posix mode treats options and escapes differently
End of input in an incomplete line of an interactive shell on a pipe: prompts and diagnostics differ
GNU's matcher returns different (non-POSIX) results for * followed by a nullable extglob
Bash 5.3 ${ cmd; } and ${| cmd; } command substitutions are not implemented (printed literally)
getopts ignores OPTIND changes made between calls
GLOBIGNORE is not implemented
History expansion (!!) inside double quotes, command substitutions and pastes, and :p/error policies differ
cmdhist/lithist storage of multi-line commands in history differs
The history builtin refuses to work in a noninteractive shell
histverify and histreedit are not implemented
SIGHUP at an interactive prompt does not run the EXIT trap or save history
-i without a terminal: no 'no job control' warnings, prompts or exit announcement on stderr
Job control builtins are partial: jobs -n/SPEC, per-stage listings, stop signals, Done notifications, bg, fg errors
No locale model: LC_ALL=C byte semantics and Bash's per-character case mapping are not implemented
mapfile -C/-c is not implemented
A {fd}>file redirection on a builtin is closed after the command; Bash keeps it open
NUL bytes in shell input are kept as word characters, and in values are not truncated, where Bash drops them
In posix mode an assignment before a special builtin does not persist
printf: %b keeps \" escapes and \c stops all output in Bash; empty numeric arguments are errors in Bash
Prompt strings: quote removal and brace expansion are applied, \nnn and \001/\002 handled differently, controls not made visible
read: backslash-escaped IFS characters, read -t 0 at end of file, read -n 1 of ^D from a terminal
bind: macro bindings and some key-sequence spellings are not supported by the reedline editor
Programmable completion quoting (-o filenames/fullquote/noquote) and escaped insertion differ
bind -x: READLINE_LINE/READLINE_POINT semantics (character vs byte point, unset, continuation lines) differ
An external command's redirection words are expanded in the shell, so their side effects persist
[[ =~ ]] uses fancy-regex, not POSIX ERE: leftmost-first alternation; an invalid regex is status 1 with a log line
A negative subscript on a sparse array counts from the element count, not the highest index
Invocation options: +x short options, -a/-B/-E/-T/-h, - and + terminators, invalid -o/-O names, option listings
A script read from stdin is read ahead, so exec 0< or closing stdin does not change the script's input
Builtin and expansion gaps from the upstream TCK selection (one line each in the doc)
A CHLD trap does not run
unset stops at a readonly name instead of continuing with the rest
set -v does not echo input lines
xtrace prints a quoted [[ =~ ]] operand as written, not in Bash's backslash-quoted form
